name: Forge
description: Rust-based terminal coding agent that works with many model providers and can isolate tasks in git worktree sandboxes.
whatItDoes: Forge is an AI pair programmer for the shell. It implements features, fixes bugs, explains code and can write commit messages. It is for developers who prefer a fast native CLI over an editor plugin.
howItWorks: After logging in to a provider, the user runs the agent interactively or with a single prompt. The agent uses file and shell tools, can attach external tool servers through configuration, and can work inside a separate worktree to keep the main checkout untouched.

requirements.name: Model provider account or API key
requirements.description: Set up with the provider login command
